source.title: Auction Detonator v0.12.0-beta — Oct 28 Retail Midnight disenchant support
source.author: Bubbledude

quote: Disenchant in Retail: what greens, blues and epics give from Warlords of Draenor to Midnight
notes: Distinct newly identified prospective original-data supplier: the author-supported Retail 12.1.5 beta promises expansion-aware disenchant output estimates for greens/blues/epics and item-level-aware gear identity. The published changelog has NO documented source-original player cohort, input itemLink/bonus/actual ilvl, character skill/spec, material output receipt, completed-cast denominator, castsWithDrop, zero events, histogram, refund, or study lineage. The later v0.21.34-beta release explicitly fixes lost hand-disenchant observations after cancelled casts, but that file is labeled Classic TBC/Classic/Forever only; DO NOT extrapolate its collector behavior or data to Retail. No numeric data or disenchant eligibility imported; values displayed by this addon could be heuristics. Follow up only if the author shares permitted raw Retail individual events and exactly which version recorded them. Previous Cardinalai, Honeybone, MikiMM, kyzenbka and Wowhead Looter samples were not copied.
lookingFor: Unpublished original Retail Midnight addon disenchant operation logs and provenance behind Auction Detonator's Warlords-to-Midnight output tables, especially Miststalker's Wristbands 272246 actual variant vs generic item-level 206 and uncommon/rare/epic armor/weapon yield cohorts
